title: These birthday cake muffins are EVERYTHING
summary: ! Fluffy, sweet, and loaded with sprinkles—perfect for birthdays, brunch, or just treating yourself!
steps: In a separate bowl, combine milk, yogurt, eggs, vanilla and melted butter.
Gently fold the wet ingredients into the dry.
Don't over mix or your muffins won't be as fluffy.
Now, fold in 3 quarters of the sprinkles and don't forget to save some for the top.
Spoon the batter into a mini muffin tray and top with the remaining sprinkles.
Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 to 12 minutes, then let them cool.
